entries.title: Proverbs 10:1
segments: The proverbs of Solomon.  A wise son maketh a glad father; But a foolish son is the heaviness of his mother.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:2
segments: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing; But righteousness delivereth from death.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:3
segments: Jehovah will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish; But he thrusteth away the desire of the wicked.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:4
segments: He becometh poor that worketh with a slack hand; But the hand of the diligent maketh rich.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:5
segments: He that gathereth in summer is a wise son; [But] he that sleepeth in harvest is a son that causeth shame.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:6
segments: Blessings are upon the head of the righteous; But violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:7
segments: The memory of the righteous is blessed; But the name of the wicked shall rot.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:8
segments: The wise in heart will receive commandments; But a prating fool shall fall.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:9
segments: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely; But he that perverteth his ways shall be known.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:10
segments: He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow; But a prating fool shall fall.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:11
segments: The mouth of the righteous is a fountain of life; But violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:12
segments: Hatred stirreth up strifes; But love covereth all transgressions.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:13
segments: In the lips of him that hath discernment wisdom is found; But a rod is for the back of him that is void of understanding.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:14
segments: Wise men lay up knowledge; But the mouth of the foolish is a present destruction.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:15
segments: The rich man's wealth is his strong city: The destruction of the poor is their poverty.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:16
segments: The labor of the righteous [tendeth] to life; The increase of the wicked, to sin.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:17
segments: He is in the way of life that heedeth correction; But he that forsaketh reproof erreth.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:18
segments: He that hideth hatred is of lying lips; And he that uttereth a slander is a fool.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:19
segments: In the multitude of words there wanteth not transgression; But he that refraineth his lips doeth wisely.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:20
segments: The tongue of the righteous is [as] choice silver: The heart of the wicked is little worth.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:21
segments: The lips of the righteous feed many; But the foolish die for lack of understanding.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:22
segments: The blessing of Jehovah, it maketh rich; And he addeth no sorrow therewith.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:23
segments: It is as sport to a fool to do wickedness; And [so is] wisdom to a man of understanding.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:24
segments: The fear of the wicked, it shall come upon him; And the desire of the righteous shall be granted.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:25
segments: When the whirlwind passeth, the wicked is no more; But the righteous is an everlasting foundation.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:26
segments: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, So is the sluggard to them that send him.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:27
segments: The fear of Jehovah prolongeth days; But the years of the wicked shall be shortened.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:28
segments: The hope of the righteous [shall be] gladness; But the expectation of the wicked shall perish.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:29
segments: The way of Jehovah is a stronghold to the upright; But it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:30
segments: The righteous shall never be removed; But the wicked shall not dwell in the land.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:31
segments: The mouth of the righteous bringeth forth wisdom; But the perverse tongue shall be cut off.

entries.title: Proverbs 10:32
segments: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable; But the mouth of the wicked [speaketh] perverseness.
